content_sections.heading: PJTAU Teaching Associate Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of a demo class on a topic relevant to the course, followed by an interview. Candidates must come prepared for a demo class on a topic relevant to the course. Experience in Teaching, Knowledge of Computers & Handling online classes are essential.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PJTAU Teaching Associate
content_sections.text: Check the official notification details and eligibility criteria. Prepare all original certificates, bio-data, and other relevant documents along with two photocopies. Ensure you are prepared for a demo class on a topic relevant to the course. Attend the walk-in interview on 13.10.2026 at 10:00 AM. Report at the Office of the Associate Dean, Agricultural College, Dichpally, Nizamabad District located at Institute of Biotechnology (IBT), PJTAU Campus, Rajendranagar, Hyderabad-30.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Original certificates Two photocopies of all original certificates Bio-data Other relevant documents No objection certificate (if employed)

content_sections.heading: PJTAU Teaching Associate Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA & DA will be paid for attending the interview. The above posts are purely temporary. Interested candidates along with the 2 photocopies of all original certificates, Bio-data and other relevant documents may attend the interview. No objection certificate if employed. The decision by the selection committee is final and binding in all aspects. The selected candidates must and should work at Agricultural College located near at Dichpally, Nizamabad District campus as per the instructions of the University.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Professor Jayashankar Telangana Agricultural University (PJTAU) is conducting this recruitment.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 temporary vacancies for Teaching Associate and Part-time Teacher posts.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 13 October 2026 at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the Office of the Associate Dean, Agricultural College, Dichpally, Nizamabad District located at Institute of Biotechnology (IBT), PJTAU Campus, Rajendranagar, Hyderabad-30.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Teaching Associate posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. or Ph.D. (Ag) in the relevant discipline (Soil Science, Plant Pathology, or Genetics and Plant Breeding).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Teaching Associate posts?
faq.answer: The maximum consolidated pay is Rs. 54,000 per month for Ph.D. and Rs. 49,000 per month for M.Sc. candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a demo class on a relevant topic and an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Are these posts permanent?
faq.answer: No, the posts are purely temporary.

faq.question: Q10. Is an experience in teaching required?
faq.answer: Experience in teaching, knowledge of computers, and handling online classes are noted as essential.
